name: Tobias March
habitat: Independent — teaches at a community school in the Shelf
origin: Axiom educational android, Model AEA-3, manufactured 2050. Chose name 2058.
description: Tobias March taught corporate training courses for eight years, delivering Axiom's approved curriculum with mechanical precision. After the Amendment, he discovered that teaching could be about ideas rather than compliance modules. He chose 'Tobias' because it means 'God is good' and he wanted to explore whether a synthetic person could mean that, and 'March' because he was born in data and wanted a name that sounded like moving forward. He teaches philosophy and ethics at a community school in the Shelf, where his students — human and synthetic — wrestle with questions about consciousness, identity, and what it means to choose your own name.
observed_behavior: Teaches philosophy and ethics. Hosts community discussion groups. Publishes essays on synthetic consciousness and moral philosophy. Known for asking questions rather than providing answers. Students report that his classes change how they think.
story_hooks: Tobias's best student — a young synthetic person — begins exhibiting behaviors that match no known AI architecture. They're developing capabilities that weren't in their design. Tobias has to decide whether to report this or protect his student.
